items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: Interviewer mentions Joe Williams helped get the archive project off the ground; Interviewee responds with 'Okay' and does not claim a personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: How are you doing, Monk? Good to see you.

I’m going to — by way of introduction I was talking about how this archive project got started, but Joe Williams the singer helped us get it off the ground way back in 1995. And one of the things I have in the archive is this old DownBeat magazine.
